source.description:
## PROBLEM
Local checkout (/home/dawid/dev/core) and origin (xtrm-dev/core) must be verified in sync; open PRs, stale branches, and working-tree state triaged so main is clean and ready for a future release.
## SUCCESS
- Local main == origin/main, working tree clean, remote-tracking refs pruned.
- Every open non-dependabot PR dispositioned (merge candidate / needs rebase / close) with evidence; no action taken without operator approval except safe sync.
- Release-readiness checklist verified (HEAD CI, version/CHANGELOG state, required checks).
- No release or publish performed.
## SCOPE
git state, open PRs, local branches/worktrees/stash/tags, HEAD CI, release workflow presence.
## NON_GOALS
No merges, no closes, no release/publish, no code changes unless trivially safe and approved.
## CONSTRAINTS
Ask before destructive or origin-mutating actions. Read-only investigation first.
## VALIDATION
- [ ] git status clean, main == origin/main (hashes shown)
- [ ] PR disposition table with mergeable/checks/evidence
- [ ] Release-readiness checklist with pass/fail + evidence
## OUTPUT
Situation report + ordered reconcile actions awaiting approval.
source.title: Reconcile core repo: local/origin sync + release-ready (no release)
